blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine Blu Girls kept a tight grip on fourth spot in women’s softball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after routing Singapore, 10-0, in four innings on Wednesday at Anjo Softball Ground. Mylia Isabel Perez and Nicole Hammoude hit two-run homers to lead another convincing win for the Blu Girls, who continued their turnaround from a rough start in the preliminary round. Coach Ana Santiago’s squad improved to 3-2 to stay in contention to at least enter Saturday’s bronze-medal match, but will face a massive test on […]...
